title: Orders sandbox composite index
summary: Mode C on the orders_ecommerce demo workload (ROADMAP Phase 3, T3.9): context comes from a sandbox clone (plain EXPLAIN), the Optimization Engineer must propose the composite index on (customer_id, created_at), an approval row must be written before any sandbox DDL, and the deterministic benchmark decides the outcome. `inconclusive` is accepted for the documented noisy-hardware case (ADR-0018); a rejection is not.
label: Prerecorded demonstration. Agent answers recorded from nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free on 2026-10-16; benchmark measurements recorded in a local Docker sandbox on 2026-10-16. Shown from stored records: not a live run, not your database.
